name: green hag
desc: Green Hag is a CR 3 fey.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: coven magic
actions.desc: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.int.dc]]): @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAugury0000]{Augury}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindFamili]{Find Familiar}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplIdentify00]{Identify}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLocateObje]{Locate Object}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplUnseenServ]{Unseen Servant}. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

actions.name: mimicry
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful [[/check format=long]].

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +4 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDancingLig]{Dancing Lights}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDisguiseSe]{Disguise Self} (24-hour duration), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility} (self only, and the hag leaves no tracks while Invisible), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMinorIllus]{Minor Illusion}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{Ray of Sickness} (level 3 version)
